explainedBy: The Pinto is a sealed box in the sun: the car that will not start is the trap.

storyboard.claim: The family is stuck in a broken car in the heat.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A closed car box with heat waves rising from it.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Cold open.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the car and shows it sealed and hot before any person appears.

explainedBy: The sealed car keeps getting hotter: the same box, the heat rising.

storyboard.claim: The heat inside the sealed car keeps rising.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The same sealed car box, the heat waves growing stronger.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same sealed car, now the heat builds inside it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the rising heat to the box shown in the beat before.

explainedBy: The boy is losing consciousness from the heat while his mother watches him.

storyboard.claim: A six-year-old boy is slipping into heat coma while his mother watches.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tad lies collapsed and out cold; Donna beside him, worried, watching.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The car box gives way to the people inside it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the boy unconscious and the mother watching, not just described.

explainedBy: The mother cannot help: fear and helplessness in the face of her child's suffering.

storyboard.claim: The mother is completely helpless and it is suffocating.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Donna, afraid, alone in the frame.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Stays with Donna after the boy.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the helplessness a face of fear.

explainedBy: The dog is outside the car window, waiting on the gravel.

storyboard.claim: A rabid dog waits outside the cracked window.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, angry, standing outside the car on the gravel.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the trapped family to the threat outside.
storyboard.addedInformation: Introduces the dog as the threat outside the car.

explainedBy: The dog waits for the family to open the door.

storyboard.claim: The dog is waiting for them to open the door.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The same angry dog, still outside, waiting.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same dog, now waiting.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the waiting explicit: the door is the trap.

explainedBy: The hosts are analysing a novel, the source they were sent.

storyboard.claim: This is a deep dive into the novel Kujo.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The book title card, a novel title on screen.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the scene to the source.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the source as a novel.

explainedBy: The hosts reject a plain monster story as their subject.

storyboard.claim: The episode is not a monster story about a scary dog.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Nothing on screen but the struck phrase.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The source is set; now the hosts reject a reading of it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Rejects the dog-horror reading.

explainedBy: The episode has one central argument to prove.

storyboard.claim: The episode will prove one argument.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Only the callout: an argument, no figure.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the thesis.
storyboard.addedInformation: Frames the argument as the point of the video.

explainedBy: The real horror is three ordinary failures in one family, shown as parts of one structure.

storyboard.claim: The horror is ordinary failures inside one family.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A sorter with three buckets: broken car, answered phone, marriage coming apart.
storyboard.onScreenText: Broken down car / Answered phone / Marriage coming apart
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the thesis to its three parts.
storyboard.addedInformation: Lists the three everyday failures as the parts of the horror.

explainedBy: The family, not the monster, builds the trap that holds them.

storyboard.claim: The family builds the trap that holds them, not the monster.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The car as the trap the family builds.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the parts to the trap they make.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the people build the trap, not the dog.

explainedBy: The hosts will look at the situation before the trap closes.

storyboard.claim: We must look at the situation before the trap closes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Only the callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Transition to the people.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sets the time frame: before the trap closes.

explainedBy: Donna and Vic are a married couple whose marriage is already cracking.

storyboard.claim: The Trentons' marriage is cracked.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Donna, worried, and Vic, neutral, standing apart in a suburban setting.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the trap to the people in it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives the couple faces that show the strain.

explainedBy: Donna had an affair with Steve Kemp, and Kemp has the menacing smirk of the affair partner.

storyboard.claim: Donna had an affair with Steve Kemp.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Donna, worried, beside Kemp, smirking.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the marriage to the affair within it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the affair as a pairing between Donna and Kemp.

explainedBy: The boy picks up on the tension in the house.

storyboard.claim: Tad is highly sensitive to the tension in the house.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tad, worried, in the kitchen.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the affair to the child who feels it.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the boy sensing the house's tension.

explainedBy: The farm sits at the end of a dead-end road.

storyboard.claim: The Camber farm is at the end of a dead-end road.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A road icon: the dead-end farm road.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the family to the place.
storyboard.addedInformation: Places the farm on a road with no way through.

explainedBy: The road leads only to the farm: the place is isolated.

storyboard.claim: The farm is incredibly isolated.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The same road icon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same road, now isolation.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the isolation the road implies.

explainedBy: Kujo is the friendly family dog, before he changes.

storyboard.claim: Kujo is the Cambers' friendly St. Bernard.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, happy, a friendly St. Bernard.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the farm to its dog.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the dog before the infection, a genuine warmth.

explainedBy: The friendly dog is about to become the threat.

storyboard.claim: The dog is about to become the ultimate threat.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, worried, the same friendly dog.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the friendly dog to the change coming.
storyboard.addedInformation: Foreshadows the turn in the dog.

explainedBy: Kujo is young and playful, the start of the timeline.

storyboard.claim: Kujo is five years old and still playful.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, happy, young and playful.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts the timeline with the dog.
storyboard.addedInformation: Gives Kujo's age and playful nature.

explainedBy: Kujo chases a rabbit: the playful deed that starts the chain.

storyboard.claim: Kujo chases a rabbit across a meadow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, happy, walking in pursuit.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the dog's age to what he does.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the chase.

callout.text: KUJO FOLLOWS THE RABBIT INTO THE CAVE

explainedBy: Kujo follows the rabbit into a cave.

storyboard.claim: Kujo follows the rabbit into a limestone cave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, neutral, walking into the cave in the forest.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the chase to the cave.
storyboard.addedInformation: Places the dog inside the cave.

explainedBy: The cave's damp smell: wet earth and the stench of bat ammonia.

storyboard.claim: The cave is damp and smells of wet earth and bat ammonia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, neutral, in the same cave.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same cave, now the smell.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the smell of the cave.

explainedBy: The dog's barking wakes the bats: the barking is the trigger.

storyboard.claim: Kujo's barking wakes a roost of bats.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo in the same cave, the barking as the cause.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same cave; the trigger is the barking.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the barking as the cause of the bats waking.

explainedBy: The bats are infected with rabies, a fearful danger in the dark cave.

storyboard.claim: The bats are infected with a virulent rabies strain.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, afraid, in the dark cave.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same cave; the bats are revealed as the danger.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the infection and the fear it brings.

explainedBy: Kujo snaps at a bat and the crunch of its wing is in his mouth.

storyboard.claim: Kujo snaps at a rabid bat and bites into its wing.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, angry, the bat's wing in his mouth.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the cave to the bite.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the bite the dog takes.

explainedBy: The bat scratches Kujo's muzzle, leaving a question-mark scratch.

storyboard.claim: The bat leaves a small scratch shaped like a question mark on his nose.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, worried, with the scratch on his nose.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same dog; now the scratch.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the wound the callout names.

explainedBy: The wound is so small it is barely noticed: the danger is hidden.

storyboard.claim: The wound is so small you would barely notice it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, neutral, the same wound.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same dog, the wound is minimal.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says the wound is easy to miss.

explainedBy: Real disasters do not announce themselves: no sirens, no soundtrack.

storyboard.claim: True disasters arrive without warning signs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Only the callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the wound to the disaster's arrival.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says disasters come without warning.

explainedBy: The disaster starts on an ordinary afternoon with the dog chasing a rabbit.

storyboard.claim: It starts on a sunny ordinary afternoon with a dog chasing a rabbit.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, happy, walking, on a sunny afternoon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the warning to the ordinary day.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the sunny ordinary day.

explainedBy: The hosts now explain the biology of the infection.

storyboard.claim: The biology of what happens in the cave is crucial.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Only the callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the afternoon to the biology.
storyboard.addedInformation: Announces the explanation.

explainedBy: The rabies virus is a bullet-shaped virus.

storyboard.claim: The rabies virus is bullet-shaped.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Only the callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the announcement to the virus itself.
storyboard.addedInformation: Describes the virus shape.

explainedBy: The virus avoids the blood, where the immune system would flag it.

storyboard.claim: The virus bypasses the bloodstream.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Only the callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the virus to how it moves.
storyboard.addedInformation: States the route avoids the blood.

explainedBy: The virus binds to the nerve endings in the nose and muscle: the start of the chain.

storyboard.claim: The virus binds to nerve endings in the nose and muscle.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A flow: the first label, nose and muscle nerves.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the bloodstream bypass to the nerve endings it hits first.
storyboard.addedInformation: Starts the cause-effect chain of the infection.

explainedBy: The virus crawls slowly up the nerves: the next step of the chain.

storyboard.claim: The virus crawls slowly up the axons of the nervous system.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The same flow, the second label added: slow crawl up the axons.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same chain, one more step.
storyboard.addedInformation: Adds the crawl along the nerves.

explainedBy: The virus reaches the brain, the end of the chain, while the dog looks fine for weeks.

storyboard.claim: The virus reaches the central nervous system and the brain.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The same flow with the brain as the last label.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Same chain, the result is the brain.
storyboard.addedInformation: Completes the chain to the brain.

explainedBy: The trap is silently winding up while Kujo's reaction is normal.

storyboard.claim: The trap silently winds itself up while the dog looks normal.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, neutral, looking ordinary.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the chain to the dog's ordinary look.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the dog seemingly fine.

explainedBy: Kujo leaves the cave with a bad dog feeling, as the text describes.

storyboard.claim: Kujo feels a bad dog feeling when he leaves the cave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Kujo, worried, walking out of the cave.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: From the chain to the dog leaving the cave.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the dog's unease as he leaves.
